note: Coarse hotel sub-themes, made mutually exclusive. Route by the aspect being evaluated, not by where it appears. Replace this file with your own bucket set.
rules: Choose the bucket for the SUBJECT being evaluated, not where the sentence sits (a dirty bathroom -> Cleanliness; a leaking shower -> Bathroom; broken AC -> Comfort). Air conditioning and room temperature always -> Comfort. Use General Experience ONLY for whole-property verdicts, star ratings, or generic praise/complaint with no specific feature.

Room & Property.Cleanliness: dirt, stains, smell, hygiene of anything in the room
Room & Property.Comfort: bed, mattress, pillows, sleep, room temperature and air conditioning, stuffiness
Room & Property.Maintenance & Condition: broken or failing things, wear, dated decor, refurbishment, building condition, power failures
Room & Property.General Experience: overall experience and general impression, star rating, value for money, the stay as a whole

Food & Drink.Food Variety & Repetition: selection and monotony of the menu
Food & Drink.Drinks & Bar: alcoholic drinks, cocktails, soft drinks, bar availability and service
Food & Drink.General Experience: overall food verdict with no specific feature

Staff & Service.Reception & Check-in/out: front desk, check-in/out, key cards, desk bookings
Staff & Service.Staff Attitude: friendliness, rudeness, helpfulness, kindness of people
Staff & Service.Service Responsiveness: how requests and complaints are handled, follow-up
Staff & Service.Management & Policies: management, billing, rules, tips policy, pricing disputes
Staff & Service.General Experience: overall service verdict with no specific feature

Pool & Beach.General Experience: overall pool or beach verdict with no specific feature

Spa & Wellness.Spa Facilities: jacuzzi, sauna, steam room, facility condition
Spa & Wellness.General Experience: overall spa verdict with no specific feature

Entertainment & Animation.General Experience: overall entertainment verdict with no specific feature
